prompt:
A pixel-perfect UI design mockup of a WEB APP SCREEN, tall portrait frame, rendered flat-on as a screen capture. Real app furniture: a nav, headings, a scrollable list, tappable controls. Not a photograph of an object.

App: "rootstock", a yard task planner. VISUAL WORLD: a gridded modernist type specimen where the construction grid stays visible as part of the design. Ground is near-white #F6F7F8 carrying a faint pale blue construction grid #C9DEF7 of small squares across the ENTIRE screen, clearly visible but quiet. Near-black #0B0B0C type. ONE saturated blue #1156F8 as the single accent, used ONLY for: the active nav underline, a filled record control, the evidence line, and the grid toggle. Secondary text is grey #5C6166. Every element snaps to whole grid cells. No rounded corners, no shadows, no cards. Division is hairline rules only.

LAYOUT top to bottom, filling the whole tall frame:
1. App bar: "rootstock" at left in heavy condensed lowercase, large. At right a small solid blue square containing "GRID" in tiny white caps.
2. Nav row: "PLAN" in bold condensed caps, blue, with a blue underline bar beneath it; then "YARD" and "RULES" in bold condensed black caps.
3. A large page heading in bold condensed black caps: "THIS WEEK".
4. A two-line paragraph in grey body sans: "One yard in Southwest Fort Worth, Texas, planned again every morning. Every task here names the rule that asked for it and the reading that rule fired on."
5. THE TALLY BAND: a full-width horizontal strip about three grid cells tall, outlined in a black hairline, divided into 13 equal square cells by hairlines. The first three cells are white with black outlines (open work); the remaining ten are faint pale blue (nothing scheduled).
6. Directly beneath the band, one line: at left in bold condensed black caps "3 JOBS / 0 RECORDED / 3 OPEN", at right in condensed grey caps "SOUTHWEST FORT WORTH, TEXAS / ZONE 8B".
7. A small section label in condensed grey caps: "THE WEEK IN THE YARD". Beneath it in black body sans, two lines: "It is a lawn-focused week: handle the fall weed-prevention application, make the season's final nitrogen feeding, and feed the Esperanza container."
8. A small section label in condensed grey caps: "READY NOW". Beneath it in grey body sans, two lines: "Ticking a box records the work as done today. The yard keeps every record and changes none, so a tick cannot be taken back."
9. First task row, preceded by a full-width black hairline. At the far left a square checkbox with a black outline, empty, roughly one grid cell. To its right, stacked: the job name in large bold condensed black caps "FALL PRE-EMERGENT"; on the same line but right-aligned at the far right edge, "FRONT LAWN" in condensed grey caps; below the job name, in black body sans, "Apply fall pre-emergent to the front lawn, then irrigate it in according to the product label."; below that, in BLUE MONOSPACED caps with wide spacing, "WINDOW / SEP 15 2026".
10. Beneath that task, a small grey note line with a tiny outline circle-i icon: "Water in after application: Irrigate after spreading, following the product label."
11. Beneath that, a disclosure line in blue: a small chevron then "Rule and reading" in blue bold, followed by "· Fall pre-emergent" in grey.
12. A full-width black hairline, then the beginning of the second task row: empty square checkbox, job name in large bold condensed black caps "LAST NITROGEN OF THE YEAR", right-aligned "FRONT LAWN" in condensed grey caps.

TYPOGRAPHY: a heavy condensed grotesque for the wordmark, headings, job names and all caps labels; a clean neutral grotesque for body sentences; a monospaced face with wide letter spacing for the blue evidence lines. All figures tabular.

Extremely high craft, absolute grid discipline, dense real information, sharp and legible. No shadows, no rounded corners, no cards, no plants, no illustration, no photographs.
note: Corrects the approved Tally comp's scope: same world, same row hierarchy, rendered with the page's real first-viewport content. Authoritative for the whole page; the Tally comp stays authoritative for the row.
